# Quantum to Participate at the Cantor Convergence Conference on November 11 and 12, 2026


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_1ced6c525021bbbf791caca5cad73a5f/quantum/news/2026-11-03_Quantum_to_Participate_at_the_Cantor_Convergence_273.pdf) November 03, 2026 4:05pm EST


CENTENNIAL, Colo.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Quantum Corporation (Nasdaq: QMCO) ("Quantum" or the "Company"), today announced **** that Hugues Meyrath, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate at the Cantor Convergence 4th Annual Crypto, FinTech, AI & Energy Infrastructure Conference to be held at the Ritz-Carlton South Beach in Miami, Florida. Management will be available to host scheduled meetings on November 11 and 12 with participating investors.


Portfolio managers and analysts who would like to request a meeting with management should contact their Cantor representative.


**About Quantum**


Quantum delivers end-to-end data management solutions designed for the AI era. With over four decades of experience, our data platform has allowed customers to extract the maximum value from their unique, unstructured data. From high-performance ingest that powers AI applications and demanding data-intensive workloads, to massive, durable data lakes to fuel AI models, Quantum delivers the most comprehensive and cost-efficient solutions. Leading organizations in life sciences, government, media and entertainment, research, and industrial technology trust Quantum with their most valuable asset – their data. For more information visit[www.quantum.com](http://www.quantum.com/) .
